title: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting - Cultural and Creative Arts - Types of Crafts
exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which of the following is classified as a fabric craft?
questions.explain: Tie and dye is a fabric craft that involves folding, tying, and dyeing 100% cotton fabric to create unique patterns.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Blacksmithing is a craft that focuses on the manipulation of which of the following materials?
questions.explain: Blacksmithing involves heating and forging metals like iron into functional tools such as cutlasses, hoes, and decorative items.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Basketry and mat making fall strictly under which classification of craft?
questions.explain: Woven craft involves interlacing threads, fibers, or strips (like palm fronds or cane) to make items such as baskets and mats.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Vases, pots, and jugs made from clay are typical examples of which type of craft?
questions.explain: Moulded craft involves shaping pliable materials such as clay or paper mâché into specific 3D forms like vases.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which of the following materials is most commonly associated with carving and caning crafts?
questions.explain: Carving is mostly done on hard surfaces by removing excess material. Wood and calabash are the primary traditional materials used in Nigerian carving crafts.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: The production of bags, shoes, and belts from processed animal skin is known as:
questions.explain: Leather craft entails making functional and decorative objects from tanned animal hides and skins.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: A decorative kite designed by a student is best classified under:
questions.explain: Paper crafts involve creating 2D or 3D forms using paper materials, and kite-making is a classic example of this.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which craft explicitly involves the mixture of pulped paper and a binder (like starch or glue) to mold solid objects?
questions.explain: Paper mâché translates to 'chewed paper'. It involves mixing pulped paper or paper strips with adhesive to mold strong 3D objects.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts
